title: Contractive global extension from admissible scalar values
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] with a multiplicative absolute value $|\cdot|:K\to\mathbf R_{\geq0}$ satisfying $|a|=0\iff a=0$, $|1|=1$, $|ab|=|a||b|$, and $|a+b|\leq\max(|a|,|b|)$. Let $V$ be a $K$-vector space with a norm $\|\cdot\|:V\to\mathbf R_{\geq0}$ satisfying $\|v\|=0\iff v=0$, $\|av\|=|a|\|v\|$, and $\|v+w\|\leq\max(\|v\|,\|w\|)$. A $K$-linear map means an additive map preserving multiplication by scalars. Assume the following scalar-value condition: for every $K$-linear subspace $U\subseteq V$, every $K$-linear $g:U\to K$ with $|g(u)|\leq\|u\|$ for all $u\in U$, and every $x\in V\setminus U$, there is $b\in K$ with $|b-g(u)|\leq\|x-u\|$ for every $u\in U$. Then, for every $K$-linear subspace $W\subseteq V$ and every $K$-linear $f:W\to K$ satisfying $|f(w)|\leq\|w\|$ for every $w\in W$, there exists a $K$-linear $h:V\to K$ such that $h(w)=f(w)$ for every $w\in W$ and $|h(v)|\leq\|v\|$ for every $v\in V$. No completeness, compactness, closedness, or dimension hypothesis is imposed on $V$ or $W$.

proof.text: Fix $W,f$ as in the statement. To verify one-vector extendability, take any subspace $W\subseteq U\subseteq V$, any contractive linear extension $g:U\to K$ of $f$, and any $x\notin U$. The scalar-value hypothesis applied to these $U,g,x$ gives $b\in K$ with $|b-g(z)|\leq\|x-z\|$ for all $z\in U$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent scalar-extension expansion: the assumed admissible value for an arbitrary bounded partial extension

proof.text: Every vector of $U+Kx$ has a unique expression $u+ax$ with $u\in U$, $a\in K$: if $u+ax=u\prime+a\prime x$ and $a\ne a\prime$, then $x=(a-a\prime)^{-1}(u\prime-u)\in U$, a contradiction; hence $a=a\prime$ and $u=u\prime$. Define $G(u+ax)=g(u)+ab$. For $u,v\in U$ and $a,c,t\in K$, the formulas $G((u+ax)+(v+cx))=g(u)+g(v)+(a+c)b=G(u+ax)+G(v+cx)$ and $G(t(u+ax))=tg(u)+tab=tG(u+ax)$ prove linearity. Taking $a=0$ gives $G|_U=g$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent scalar-extension expansion: explicit linear map on the direct sum U+Kx

proof.text: If $a=0$, then $|G(u)|=|g(u)|\leq\|u\|$. If $a\ne0$, put $z=-a^{-1}u\in U$. Then $u+ax=a(x-z)$ and $G(u+ax)=a(b-g(z))$, so the chosen inequality and multiplicativity give $$|G(u+ax)|=|a|\,|b-g(z)|\leq |a|\,\|x-z\|=\|u+ax\|.$$ Thus the explicitly constructed extension has the same contractive bound on all of $U+Kx$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent scalar-extension expansion: normalization of each nonzero scalar coefficient and the contractive estimate

proof.text: For nonnegative real numbers $r,s$, if $r\leq s$ then $\max(r,s)=s\leq r+s$, and otherwise $\max(r,s)=r\leq r+s$. Applying this to $|a|,|b|$ and to $\|v\|,\|w\|$ shows that the given scalar absolute value and vector norm satisfy the ordinary triangle inequalities. All other field, absolute-value and norm axioms required by the bounded-extension lemma are already explicit hypotheses of the statement.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent scalar-extension expansion: ordinary triangle inequalities needed by the existing bounded-extension lemma

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-bounded-extension-zorn] with the given $K,V,W,f$ and $C=1$. Step 4 verifies its triangle inequalities, $1>0$ verifies its constant hypothesis, and the bound on $f$ is exactly $|f(w)|\leq 1\|w\|$. For each $W\subseteq U\subseteq V$, each linear $g:U\to K$ restricting to $f$ with $|g(u)|\leq1\|u\|$, and each $x\notin U$, steps 1–3 give the required linear $G:U+Kx\to K$, with $G|_U=g$ and $|G(y)|\leq1\|y\|$. The cited global-existence conclusion therefore gives a linear $h:V\to K$ restricting to $f$ with $|h(v)|\leq1\|v\|=\|v\|$ for every $v$. No completeness, compactness, closedness, or dimension condition is required by that conclusion.

lean.statement: theorem exists_contractive_extension_of_admissible_values {K : Type u} [Field K] {V : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (scalarAbs : K → NNReal) (vectorNorm : V → NNReal) (habs_zero : ∀ a : K, scalarAbs a = 0 ↔ a = 0) (habs_one : scalarAbs 1 = 1) (habs_mul : ∀ a b : K, scalarAbs (a * b) = scalarAbs a * scalarAbs b) (habs_add : ∀ a b : K, scalarAbs (a + b) ≤ max (scalarAbs a) (scalarAbs b)) (hnorm_zero : ∀ y : V, vectorNorm y = 0 ↔ y = 0) (hnorm_smul : ∀ (a : K) (y : V), vectorNorm (a • y) = scalarAbs a * vectorNorm y) (hnorm_add : ∀ y z : V, vectorNorm (y + z) ≤ max (vectorNorm y) (vectorNorm z)) (hadmissible : ∀ (U : Submodule K V) (g : U →ₗ[K] K), (∀ z : U, scalarAbs (g z) ≤ vectorNorm (z : V)) → ∀ x : V, x ∉ U → ∃ b : K, ∀ z : U, scalarAbs (b - g z) ≤ vectorNorm (x - (z : V))) (W : Submodule K V) (f : W →ₗ[K] K) (hf : ∀ w : W, scalarAbs (f w) ≤ vectorNorm (w : V)) : ∃ h : V →ₗ[K] K, (∀ w : W, h (w : V) = f w) ∧ ∀ y : V, scalarAbs (h y) ≤ vectorNorm y
